module_summary: Source half of a 2-phase CDC: accepts valid/ready data, toggles a request register and holds data, synchronizing the async ack to regenerate ready.

anchors.name: req_src_q
anchors.why: 2-phase request toggle register; flips on each accepted item and drives async_req_o.

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Holds accepted data stable for the destination domain until acknowledged.

anchors.name: src_accept
anchors.why: Valid and ready handshake; enables toggle of req_src_q and load of data_src_q.

anchors.name: ack_synced
anchors.why: Ack synchronized into source clock; compared with req_src_q to form ready.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source-side valid of the incoming data item.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Ready when request and synchronized ack phases match.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input data captured into data_src_q on accept.

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Async 2-phase request to destination domain, copy of req_src_q.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Async 2-phase acknowledge from destination, synchronized via tc_sync.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Async data bus to destination, driven by data_src_q.

groups.name: Source handshake
groups.description: Valid/ready input side; accept enables request toggle and data capture.

groups.name: 2-phase request/data
groups.description: Toggle request register and held data driving the async CDC bus.

groups.name: Ack synchronizer
groups.description: Multi-stage synchronizer bringing async ack into source clock domain.
